response.sql:
WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT
  observstation,
  avg_bandusagepct,
  telescope_count,
  telescope_count * 1.0 / AVG(telescope_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average_count
FROM station_counts
ORDER BY ratio_to_average_count DESC, observstation
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average telescope count is the unweighted mean of per-station counts, considering only stations with at least one telescope, as requested.
